chapters.title: Getting Started with Next.js
chapters.description: Discover the React framework for production. Set up your first Next.js app and understand its superpowers. 🚀

chapters.description: Make it beautiful. Global CSS, CSS Modules, Tailwind, images, fonts, and SEO with the Metadata API.
